name: clip7_whats_new
objective: What are you most excited for? Source: Blizzard.
pages: A permanent version of original Azeroth, level 60. Blizzard: not a mode, a season or a new version of Classic.
All nine classes are playable on both factions.
Talents unlock at level 10. Dual Specialization at level 40.
The Skyborne, starting on Zephras Isle.
From Hall of Thanes at level 13 to Shaper's Terrace at 58-60.
Onyxia's Lair (40), Hyjal Summit (20) and Barrow Deeps (10).
15v15 battleground for levels 30-60 off Dustwallow Marsh: four bases, a central flag, first to 2000 points.
Account-wide challenges unlock perks and rewards like the Spectral Bear mount.
Now made with First Aid, so every character can craft them.
Build campfires and place profession features for group buffs.
Fill them with materials for Merchant's Favor rewards.
More raids, dungeons, PvP and Hardcore, no dates yet. Scarlet Enclave and Ashbringer are confirmed to return.
